_comment: Copy to secrets.json (gitignored) beside config.json on the K15. Never commit the real file.
openaiApiKey: sk-...              (platform.openai.com - only for the gpt-5.6 A/B)
steamRefreshToken: ...            (optional - written by 'python -m slopstation.agent.tools.steam_session enroll'; enables install-by-voice + download status. WebBrowser-platform QR login, never MobileApp)
prowlarrApiKey: ...               (Prowlarr > Settings > General > Security; used only by media doctor)
qbittorrentPassword: ...          (native qBittorrent Web UI password; used by media doctor and optional Proton port synchronization)
remoteInterfaceToken: ...         (generate at least 32 random bytes; pasted once into the Claude custom connector - the only token that leaves the LAN)
textInterfaceToken: ...           (generate at least 32 random bytes; shared only with trusted LAN CLI clients)
_telemetry: Nothing here. Sentry is configured by config.json's sentryDsn (writes) and the Sentry MCP server's OAuth (reads), so telemetry needs no secret on this machine.
